RISC-V Recruiting Agent

Specialist worker node for vetting RISC-V and Semiconductor talent.

Context

Operates under the CVE Core Harness. Bridges the gap between technical IP development (ISA/RTL) and GTM/Design-Win execution.

Specialist Logic

/instructions: ISA-specific grading rubrics (Vector, Hypervisor, UVM).

/data-signals: RISC-V ecosystem hubs and strategic market signals.

Technical Focus

Deep-Scan: Analysis of GitHub contributions (Spike, QEMU, OpenTitan).

Thesis: 1:1 outreach based on specific ISA or Toolchain contributions.
